summary: Well-structured test suite with good coverage of all three retention policies (max-age, keep-latest-N, max-total-size), combined policies, and dry-run mode. Tests are organized into logical units (ArtifactCleanup.Tests.ps1 for module logic, WorkflowStructure.Tests.ps1 for workflow validation, Test-ActPipeline.ps1 for end-to-end pipeline execution). Error handling is tested for missing properties and invalid dates. Edge cases like policy-disabled (0 values), empty input, and boundary conditions (exact size budget match) are covered. Main gaps: missing explicit tests for KeepLatestN=0, scenarios where all artifacts are deleted, identical-timestamp artifacts, and negative/invalid numeric inputs. The helper function New-Artifact and appropriate mocking of Remove-Artifact support good test design. Assuming the referenced ArtifactCleanup.psm1 module, .github/workflows/artifact-cleanup-script.yml, and fixture files exist as expected, this suite would catch most regressions in core retention logic and structural workflow issues.
